notes:
Moagram 13.2.2 preview 2

- Adds a unified Settings -> Moagram Settings hub for Ghost Mode, Hidden Chats, Local History & Media, Repeating Messages, Interface & Confirmations, Background & Delivery Health, and Updates.
- Adds a Ghost Mode quick-toggle button in the chat list header and a per-chat Mark as Read Now action when Ghost Read is enabled.
- Splits Local History & Media into its own app-wide settings screen and fixes retention toggles when Ghost Mode is off.
- Upgrades Hidden Chats settings to a dedicated screen and adds an account-wide Repeating Messages overview across all chats.
- Adds optional confirmations for calls, stickers, and GIFs, toggles to hide the Stories bar or Gift button, disable next-channel pull, show seconds in timestamps, and show copyable User/Group/Channel IDs on profiles.
- Fixes slow/stalled file downloads (replacing the old 1 MB chunk mod that collided with Telegram 13.x's 2 MB download byte budget) and adds a toggleable Download Speed Boost using 4 parallel connections with 256 KB pipelined chunks.
- Improves anonymous active-use reporting accuracy by excluding debug and logged-out launches, caching the collector URL, refreshing rolling 24-hour activity every 6 hours, and retrying when network reconnects.

Android 6.0 or later. Install over your existing Moagram app to keep accounts and settings.
critical_message: This update brings the new Moagram Settings hub, faster file downloads with Download Speed Boost, Ghost Mode quick controls, and improved usage reporting. Please install it.
